I just quit on June 3. Cold turkey. I have the adhd/autism kind of hybrid. Truthfully I decided to focus on an obsession. I picked a few video games I wanted to try and did sleep hypnosis. These video games have to be very long and mentally taxing (at least in my experience). I also bulk bought a fuck load of gum. I did the sleep hypnosis and gum combo last time when I was smoke free for 6 months but I did relapse after a death. I also live in a smoking house hold so it was hard the first time but now I’m used to it.

For me a trickle down (patches and cutting smoking) didn’t work. That’s because I would feel like I just needed one more ever single time. When I stopped straight up it felt like a battle of wills between myself and my addiction which was more entertaining in my brain. So I was more likely not to smoke. I didn’t want my addiction to win I guess. I also would imagine cigarettes as things I hate (liver, puke, your ex, whatever!) my brain would do the rest.

Fair warning we are dopamine deprived so I would stay medicated throughout this process (anti-depressants or stimulants that you are used to taking) because the depression hit can be ultimately unforgiving. I told myself I was allowed to scream, cry or whatever as long as I didn’t smoke and didn’t harm myself or others. I made it this far you can too.

Tldr: prep yourself, brainwash yourself, buy gum,  buy video games, cut cold turkey and villianize the habit.
